rounds.title: Empty-state baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK empty state (et-empty-state), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: a centred column (32px padding, 8px gap, at most 320px wide) with a 32px projected icon, a 14px title at weight 600, a 13px description and an optional projected action, here the default filled md et-button. States: default (file icon, title, description, Clear filters), without-action, errored (triangle icon, Try again), heading-only (no icon, no description), and action hover, active and focus-visible. The empty state has no colour or state of its own; only the action has. Fixed numbers, all passing: title 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; description (muted) 7.81:1 / 6.94:1; icon (muted, 3:1 needed) 7.81:1 / 6.94:1; action label (black on the mint fill) 15.82:1 at rest, 15.30:1 hover and focused, 9.38:1 active. Today on light the action fails WCAG 1.4.11: the bare mint fill is 1.33:1 against the page (hover and focused 1.37:1, active 2.24:1) and the focus ring is the focused mint, 1.37:1 against the page; dark: fill 13.50:1, ring 13.06:1. Q101 (filled button hover), numbers only: hover against rest fill 1.03:1 in both schemes, active against rest 1.69:1. Q98 does not arise: the empty state has no fill or edge of its own. Variants b and c apply decided rules to the projected action, not a new call: focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid (Q88) and mint on light rule a (Q99), the filled button gets a 1px inset ink edge. Because b adds an edge, Q102 arises: c is b with the edge in light-dark(ink, transparent), dark as today. Variant a shows today. Not this round's question: the button label's font, which is the button's own.

a.note: Today: the filled action is a bare mint fill, 1.33:1 against the light page (hover and focused 1.37:1, active 2.24:1); its focus ring is the focused mint, 1.37:1 against the light page, under 3:1. Dark: fill 13.50:1, ring 13.06:1. Text and icon as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided rules Q88 and Q99 rule a, not a new call: the action's focus ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, 7.68:1 against the light page (the focused ink), 13.50:1 dark; the filled action keeps the mint fill with a 1px inset ink edge: light 5.48:1 against the page and 4.13:1 against the fill (hover and focused 7.68 / 5.60, active 9.72 / 4.34). Dark: ink is the mint, so the edge merges with the rest fill (1.00:1) and shows 1.03:1 on the hover fill, 1.69:1 on the active fill; the fill carries it at 13.50:1. Picked to match the card, avatar and dialog picks. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the inset ink edge on light only: light-dark(ink, transparent). Light equal to b (ring 7.68:1, edge 5.48:1 against the page, 4.13:1 against the fill); dark as today on the fill (no edge), focus ring still ink, 13.50:1. It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; that is my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
